Usage

rl_set_blend_factors_separate(

  gl_dst_rgb,
  gl_src_alpha,
  gl_dst_alpha,
  gl_eq_rgb,
  gl_eq_alpha
)

gl_src_rgb

An integer.

gl_dst_rgb

An integer.
